name: OWM Sovereignty Lens
position: Sovereignty is practical optionality and credible exit capability, not autarky.

dimensions.name: Weight control
dimensions.question: Can the exact checkpoint be obtained and retained independently of a hosted API?

dimensions.name: License freedom
dimensions.question: Are the rights compatible with the intended use, modification, redistribution and commercialization?

dimensions.name: Deployment control
dimensions.question: Can deployment location, infrastructure and provider be chosen?

dimensions.name: Runtime portability
dimensions.question: Can the checkpoint be served across multiple compatible runtimes or stacks?

dimensions.name: Exit capability
dimensions.question: Can the operator change provider without losing access to the model layer?

note: The lens is descriptive and intentionally does not assign a single sovereignty score.
